description: By 2030, structural labor-market transformation will result in the creation of 170 million jobs and the displacement of 92 million jobs, for a net growth of 78 million jobs.

instances.assertion: By 2030, structural labor-market transformation will result in the creation of 170 million jobs and the displacement of 92 million jobs, for a net growth of 78 million jobs.
By 2030, job creation and destruction due to structural labour-market transformation will amount to 22% of today’s total jobs.
